acceptance_criteria.description: A user can log in to the application using valid credentials (username: standard_user, password: secret_sauce).
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the Login button
Verify the user is logged in and leaves the login page
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: User logs in with valid credentials

acceptance_criteria.description: Unauthenticated users cannot access application pages without first logging in.
kane_steps: Open a new browser session without logging in
Attempt to navigate directly to a protected page (e.g., /inventory.html)
Verify access is denied or the user is redirected to the login page

acceptance_criteria.description: After a successful login, the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Log in with valid credentials
Verify the browser URL indicates the inventory page
Verify the product inventory content is displayed

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page displays product tiles that each show a product name, image, and price.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Verify multiple product tiles are visible
Verify each visible product tile shows a name, image, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name image price

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can open a product detail page by clicking a product name or image on the inventory page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click a product name or image on a product tile
Verify the product detail page opens for the selected product

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page displays the product name, description, price, and an Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and open a product detail page from the inventory
Verify the product name is displayed
Verify the description, price, and Add to cart button are displayed

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can add a product to the cart from the inventory page using the Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click Add to cart on a product that is not yet in the cart
Verify the product is added to the cart
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add product to cart from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After adding a product to the cart from the inventory page, the Add to cart button label changes to Remove.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click Add to cart on a product
Verify the button label on that product changes to Remove
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button becomes Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: After adding a product to the cart, the cart badge in the top navigation updates to show the number of items in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and note the current cart badge count
Add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Verify the cart badge count increases by one and reflects the total number of items

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can remove a product from the cart on the inventory page by clicking the Remove button.
kane_steps: Log in and add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Click the Remove button on that product
Verify the product is removed from the cart

acceptance_criteria.description: After removing a product from the cart on the inventory page, the Remove button label changes back to Add to cart.
kane_steps: Log in and add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Click the Remove button on that product
Verify the button label changes back to Add to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in to the application
Navigate to /cart.html or click the cart icon in the top navigation
Verify the cart page loads successfully
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: User can navigate to cart page

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all added items with their name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in and add one or more products to the cart
Navigate to the cart page at /cart.html
Verify each added item is listed with its name, quantity, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page provides a sort dropdown in the top right that allows users to sort products.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top right of the page
Verify the sort dropdown is visible and can be opened

acceptance_criteria.description: The sort dropdown offers four options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown
Verify all four sort options are available

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting Price (low to high) sorts products so the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown
Verify Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99 is the first product listed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high sorts correctly

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting Name (A to Z) sorts products so Sauce Labs Backpack appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select Name (A to Z) from the sort dropdown
Verify Sauce Labs Backpack is the first product listed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z sorts correctly
